channel.title: NPR Topics: Education
channel.description: We've been to school. We know how education works. Right? In fact, many aspects of learning — in homes, at schools, at work and elsewhere — are evolving rapidly, along with our understanding of learning. Join us as we explore how learning happens.

item.title: How Dolly Parton's literacy work affected Indigenous communities in Australia
item.description: In Australia, the queen of country music, Dolly Parton, is being remembered for her work in advancing children's literacy, particularly in Indigenous communities.

item.title: More school districts are shrinking. New research asks whether closures work
item.description: School districts across the country are closing campuses as enrollment falls. New research says the financial savings may be smaller than expected.

item.title: A makeover for college: No gym, no meal plan and two years of work
item.description: A new model in Vermont emphasizes hands-on learning while stripping away frills like gyms and meal plans that increase costs. Other newly created institutions are also reimagining college.
